verdict.rationale: Gladia is an audio transcription API platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe confirms an official MCP server documentation page exists under Gladia's own docs (how-to-use-gladia/mcp.md), next to its official CLI. Missing for 10: details of the exposed tools and capabilities, setup and auth instructions for connecting agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
